snippet.title: It's A Flop - Steam Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Leave the ocean behind and dive into absolute landlocked anarchy. It's a Flop is a hilarious, physics-based party game where you control a flopping fish competing in a variety of minigames. Flop, spin, and slide your way past the competition.

Coming soon to Steam Next Fest! 

Wishlist and Play the demo on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4618940/Its_A_Flop/

Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/itsaflop
Website: https://itsaflop.com/
